VERSION 3.28.0.172

; infiniteCanvas.qmd - reMarkable 2 native horizontal infinite canvas
;
; Extends the stock vertically-infinite handwritten notebook page horizontally,
; inside the native xochitl editor (native pens, strokes, save, undo, render).
; Applies only when document.fileType === Document.Notebook && notePage.
; PDFs, ebooks and notebook pages inside PDFs keep stock paged behaviour.
; Disable/uninstall this file to restore stock behaviour; no file conversion.
;
; Firmware gate: VERSION 3.28.0.172 only. Every edit anchors on the exact stock
; expression it changes, so changed firmware fails instead of half-applying.
;
; Port of the canvas changes of bahadrdsr/remarkable-infinite-horizontal
; (tools/build_native_patch.py: DeviceSceneView.qml, DocumentView.qml) to a
; composable QMLDiff patch, without a native settings C++ singleton, settings
; UI or service wrapper. Unlike upstream, page swipes, swipe-to-add-page and
; the new-page button stay stock: one finger turns pages, two fingers pan.
;

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        ; Single switch read by the other two resources.
        LOCATE AFTER document
        INSERT {
            readonly property bool nativeInfinitePage: !!document && document.fileType === Document.Notebook && notePage
        }

        ; Let the native viewport pan beyond the paper width.
        TRAVERSE Component#sceneViewComponent > SceneView#view
            REBUILD limitScrollingToPaper
                LOCATE BEFORE { true }
                REMOVE LOCATED
                INSERT { !root.nativeInfinitePage }
            END REBUILD
        END TRAVERSE

        ; Hide the four dithered outside-paper overlays.
        TRAVERSE Item > Item#uiOverlay > Rectangle#leftOverlay[.size=root.leftViewportEdge]
            REDEFINE size
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                REMOVE UNTIL END
                INSERT { property real size: root.nativeInfinitePage ? 0 : root.leftViewportEdge }
            END REDEFINE
        END TRAVERSE
        TRAVERSE Item > Item#uiOverlay > Rectangle#rightOverlay[.size=root.rightViewportEdge]
            REDEFINE size
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                REMOVE UNTIL END
                INSERT { property real size: root.nativeInfinitePage ? 0 : root.rightViewportEdge }
            END REDEFINE
        END TRAVERSE
        TRAVERSE Item > Item#uiOverlay > Rectangle#topOverlay[.size=root.topViewportEdge]
            REDEFINE size
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                REMOVE UNTIL END
                INSERT { property real size: root.nativeInfinitePage ? 0 : root.topViewportEdge }
            END REDEFINE
        END TRAVERSE
        TRAVERSE Item > Item#uiOverlay > Rectangle#bottomOverlay[.size=root.bottomViewportEdge]
            REDEFINE size
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                REMOVE UNTIL END
                INSERT { property real size: root.nativeInfinitePage ? 0 : root.bottomViewportEdge }
            END REDEFINE
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        ; No horizontal snap back to the page column.
        TRAVERSE DeviceSceneView#sceneView
            REBUILD snapEnabled
                LOCATE BEFORE { !adjustViewPopup.active }
                REMOVE LOCATED
                INSERT { !adjustViewPopup.active && !sceneView.nativeInfinitePage }
            END REBUILD
        END TRAVERSE

    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
